newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Antah says wins 1.3 bln rgt road project.
newsitem.headline: Antah says wins 1.3 bln rgt road project.

text.p: Antah Holdings Bhd said its wholly-owned subsidiary has been awarded a 1.3 billion ringgit project by the Malaysian government to build a road linking the central states of Selangor and Negeri Sembilan.

The 33-year concession will include three years for building the highway, and collection of toll for 30 years from end-2000, the property development and trading firm said in a statement issued by its merchant bankers.
Construction of the 48.5 km road linking the towns of Kajang and Seremban is expected to start in the second half of this year and will be built by wholly-owned Kaseh Lebuhraya Sdn Bhd.
The project will be financed by bank borrowings and capital raising exercises, Antah said.
The company plans to list Kaseh Lebuhraya on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange in the near future, it said.
